content: OSF Tile Usage Policy (operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/): visible attribution per Attribution Guidelines (standard '© OpenStreetMap contributors'), valid HTTP Referer from web pages, identifiable User-Agent, no bulk downloading/heavy automated access. For this project the BROWSER fetches tiles directly (not the ESP32), so Referer/UA are normal browser defaults and satisfy policy; single-operator low-traffic dashboard is within acceptable light use. Leaflet's default attribution control renders the required credit. In AP mode tiles fail to load -> D-37 offline canvas fallback path.
